Commentary.Commentary: So Pakistan need 135 to win the series. The pitch has not looked too bad to bat on and the hosts are clearly the favourites heading into the break. Zimbabwe will need to bowl out of their skin to defend this. Can they manage to pull it off or will Pakistan march their way to victory? Join us for the chase to find out.

A very good bowling performance from Pakistan. They showed their superiority with the ball. Usman Qadir and Haris Rauf were the stars for the hosts as the pair finished with 3 each. The leg spinner was extremely impressive as he went under 6 rpo in his 4. Faheem Ashraf was the other bowler with a solitary wicket.

After being put into bat, Zimbabwe, fell behind the game inside the Powerplay losing 3 wickets. Their batters seemed to have got starts but no one was able to make it count. Contributions from Burl and Chigumbura down the order helped Zimbabwe cross the 130-run mark.

Very good bowling display from Pakistan. They kept plucking wickets at regular intervals and did not let the tourists build anything substantial. A very subpar batting performance from Zimbabwe and they will be disappointed with their effort with the willow.
SIX! Finishes the innings with a stylish shot! Back of a length ball on off, Burl hammers this over the mid-wicket region for a biggie. Zimbabwe end with 134/7.
Well bowled! A fuller length ball on off, Chisoro digs this out towards the cover region for a single.
Just short! Back of a length ball on off, Burl swings his bat at this and works it to wide long on. It lands just short of the fielder there and the batters exchange ends.
A short ball on off, Chisoro pulls this one to deep square leg for a single.
SWING AND A MISS! Two dots to start the final over of the innings! On a length outside off, Chisoro swings his willow again but does not connect.
PLAY AND A MISS! A length ball outside off, Chisoro swings his bat but does not connect.
FOUR! Perfect way to end the over for Zimbabwe! Back of a length ball outside off, Burl hammers this over the bowler's head and it crosses the ropes after a couple of bounces.
No run, BEATEN! Lovely bowling by Rauf! A yorker on off, Burl tries to dig this one out but he misses.
A fullish ball on middle, Chisoro pushes this to the leg side. An overthrow by the bowler will make sure that a single is collected.
Tendai Chisora walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Donald Tiripano is a goner and this is straight down the throat of the man at covers. This was hit with some power but it does not matter as this was straight to the man. Good length delivery outside off, Tiripano makes some room and smacks this towards covers but he does not get the required elevation on this as he holes out to Ashraf at covers. Another wicket for Rauf. He has been brilliant so far.
Around off on a length, pushed towards the leg side. They think about the single but Rauf does well to run and collect the ball preventing them from taking the same.
PLAY AND A MISS! Good length ball outside off, Donald looks to heave this one away but he misses it altogether.
Good length on off, Tiripano looks for the all mighty heave but it takes the outside edge and goes towards third man for a single.
Short ball on middle, Donald looks to pull but does not time it well and it goes towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! This was hit cleanly! Overpitched on off, Tiripano drives this past the bowler and through mid off and it will run away to the fence.

DROPPED! Faheem Ashraf did well to get to this but he does not scalp it properly. Good length around off, Tiripano looks to heave this to the off side but does not time it well, it goes high in the air towards covers where Ashraf runs in but is not able to catch this cleanly. A couple taken.
Length on middle, tucked to square leg for one. They thought about the second but decide not to in the end.
A short length ball on middle, Donald makes some room and guides this towards third man. The batters collect a single.
Wahab Riaz is back on.
On a length on middle, Burl heaves this towards the deep mid-wicket region and by the time the fielder cleans up in the deep, the batters collect two.
A full ball on middle, Tiripano eases this towards long on for another single.
Short of a length delivery on middle, tapped towards short third man to rotate the strike.
On middle, tucked towards square leg for one.
Back of a length ball outside off, Burl punches this through point and Haider Ali does well to run to his left, dive and stop this one. He saves one run as the batters collect three.
Good running to begin the over! Short of a good length ball on middle, Burl tucks this towards wide long on and the batters run well to come back for the second run.
Back of a length ball outside off, Burl guides this to third man to retain the strike for the next over with a single.
Short of a good length ball on off, Tiripano guides this to the third man region to cross ends. 100 up for Zimbabwe.
On the pads, tucked to the square leg region for one.
Back of a length ball on off, Donald pushes this to the point region for a quick single.
Full on middle, blocked out by Donald.
Back of a length ball on off, punched towards the deep cover region for a single.
On off, Burl tucks it to mid-wicket and keeps the strike.
Length ball around off, Tiripano comes down the rack. He does not time it well as he hits it to mid off for one.
WIDE! Faheem overcoocks the bouncer. Wided by the umpire.
Short outside off, Tiripano cuts it past point and gets a couple as the fielder from third man cleans it up.
Good length ball on off, Tiripano pushes it to mid on.
A pacy inswinger from Faheem. Tiripano looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fuller on middle, Burl milks it to long on for one.
Who walks in to bat now? It will be Donald Tiripano.

OUT! STUMPED! Usman has the last laugh! Just when it looked like Chigumbura could be Zimbabwe's saviour and take them to a good score but he has fallen as well.  A flighted leg spinner pitching on off and turning away. Chigumbura comes down the track to play at it but misses. He is too far down the track and Rizwan is too quick to whip the bails off.
Down the leg side, Chigumbura looks to flick but the ball kisses his pad and goes to Rizwan.
FOUR! Poor line from Usman! Darts it too full on the pads, Chigumbura sweeps it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
SIX! Beautifully hit. Tossed up too full outside off. It is in Chigumbura's arc. He goes downtown with it for half-a-dozen.
Another googly. Burl tucks it to mid-wicket for a run.
On the pads, Chigumbura turns it to the on side for one.
The physio is out in the middle to have a look at Usman Qadir. Looks like he got his knee caught up in the turf. The magic spray is being applied and it looks as if he will be okay to continue.

Driven but straight to cover. Fullish ball outside off, Chigumbura drives it on the up but too close to the man at cover. That should have been dispatched to the fence as that was there to be hit. The batters manage to get a run.
Fuller outside off, Burl strokes it to the right of cover and rotates the strike.
This time EC manages to punch it away from cover for a run.
Length ball around off, Chigumbura punches it to cover.
Another one on the pads, Burl turns it to square leg for one.
Back of a length on off, pushed towards cover-point.

NOT OUT! The ball is turning too much and missing the stumps. Elton Chigumbura survives and Pakistan lose one of their reviews. Another googly pitching around off and turning in. Elton fails to pick it and looks to defend. The ball misses his bat and hits Chigumbura over the knee roll. There is an appeal but the umpire turns it down.  Babar opts for the review. Replay rolls in and Ball Tracker shows that the ball is missing the leg pole.

Pakistan go for the review for this LBW appeal. The third umpire has a look at Ultra Edge a couple of times and decides that there is no contact between bat and ball. Ball Tracker comes in and it is missing the wickets. The on-field decision of not out stays on.
Tossed up on off, EC defends it.
Shorter on off, Burl cuts it towards point and rotates.

Just short! Brilliant effort from Fakhar Zaman. Full toss on off and middle. Chigumbura looks to smack it over mid-wicket but he does not time it well. The ball goes in the air, Zaman comes running in from deep mid-wicket and puts a dive but his effort is still not good enough to reach the ball on the full.
Floated on off, EC defends it to the off side.
Another googly on middle and leg. Chigumbura tickles it to the on side. The fielder sends a poor throw at the keeper's end and the backup is too far behind. They get an extra run.
On the pads, Elton tucks it to the on side and keeps the strike with a run.
Another play and a miss! Length ball outside off, Chigumbura looks to slash it on the off side but connects only with thin air.
Swing and a miss! Pacy ball which is shorter in length. It is outside off and comes back in. Chigumbura looks to pull across the line but misses.
Length ball on off, Burl taps it to extra cover for a run.
Good call! Good length ball outside off, Chigumbura looks to tap it on the off side but gets an inside edge which sees the ball go behind the stump. Burl calls for a run and they get it with ease.
Full outside off, Burl nudges it to sweeper cover for one.
Loopy around middle, Elton looks to tuck this to the leg side but he misses and it comes off his pads and goes to the leg side. A brilliant over by Qadir. Just one run and two wickets from this one.
Flighted on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
The new man in is Elton Chigumbura.

OUT! LBW! Another one bites the dust and Zimbabwe are in some trouble at the moment! Half their batting line up is back in the hut and now they lost their well set batter Wesley Madhevere too. Not what they would have wanted. Qadir bowls a loopy delivery around off, Madhevere looks to sweep this one but misses it completely. A loud appeal follows and the umpire raises his finger. Madhevere has a chat with his partner and goes for the review. Ultra Edge shows no spike. Ball Tracker comes in and there are three reds. This will remain out. Madhevere walks back, taking a review along with him. Pakistan are all over Zimbabwe right now.
Review time! Wesley Madhevere has been adjudged LBW but he has reviewed it. Can the review see him survive?
Tossed up and outside off, Burl drives it down to long off for a single.
Who will walk out to bat now? Ryan Burl is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Beautifully bowled by Usman and he gets his first wicket in this game! Another disappointment for Raza as he walks back for a mere 7 runs. Completely cleaned him up, did Qadir. Bowls a loopy delivery around off and middle, Raza skips down the track looking to go big but he does not quite read the ball, it spins into the right-hander and goes past his defense and goes onto hit the stumps. Terrific stuff from Qadir.
Tossed up around off, Raza pushes this towards point for a quick single.
PLAY AND A MISS! Outside off on a good length, Wesley looks to drive this but misses it completely.
Another dot! Short of a good length ball on middle, tucked towards short mid-wicket.
Good length delivery around off, pushed to the off side. They look for the single but decide against it in the end.
Outside off, Raza taps this towards point for a quick single.

FOUR! What a great cricketing shot! Width offered and Raza punishes him! Back of a length ball outside off, Raza camps on his back foot and punches this through the cover-point region and it runs away to the ropes.
Short of a good length ball on off, Raza punches this but finds the man at point.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Raza misses his tuck. Wided by the umpire.
Wahab is back.
Tossed up around off, Wesley pushes this to the off side. A brilliant over from Usman. Just the six from the first ball.
Tossed up around off, Madhevere looks to push this to the off side but it takes the inside edge and goes towards point.
Floated on off, played back to the bowler.

A loud appeal by the players but nothing from the umpire! Qadir bowls a googly on middle and leg, Madhevere looks to flick but misses it and gets hit on the pads. There is a loud appeal but the umpire does not flinch. Babar does not want to take the review. Might have been going down leg.
Loopy on middle, Wesley pushes it back to the bowler.

SIX! Madhevere welcomes Usman to the crease with a biggie! Bowls this on a shorter length on middle, Madhevere camps on his back foot and nails his pull past the fence at deep mid-wicket. Cracking shot.
Bowling change. Time for some spin. Time for some leg spin as Usman Qadir is into the attack.
SWING AND A MISS! Back of a length ball on off, Raza looks to pull this one but misses it altogether.
A dot this time around. Good length on off, Raza works this to the covers.
WIDE! Slips this down the leg side, Raza misses his flick. Wided.
Short of a good length ball on middle, Wesley tucks this uppishly towards deep square leg. It lands safe and the batters collect the single.
On middle, Raza pushes this towards mid off and the batters scamper through for a single.
Short of a good length delivery around the pads, Wesley tucks this to the fine leg region for one.
FOUR! Lovely timing and deft placement! On a good length outside off, Madhevere punches this past the diving fielder at point and it runs away to the ropes.
A single to end the over! Good length ball around off, pushed towards covers for a run. Zimbabwe are at 44/3 at the end of the Powerplay.
Outside off on a good length, Wesley pushes this to the man stationed at mid off.
Back of a length delivery around off, Raza waits for it, opens up the face of his bat and guides this towards third man for a single.
On off, Madhevere taps this to the point region and crosses ends for a single.

ANOTHER EDGY FOUR! Zimbabwe are dealing in just lucky boundaries by the looks of things! On a good length around off, Madhevere looks to work this to the off side but it takes the inside edge and runs away past the short fine leg fielder into the fence.
Riaz starts off with a good length ball on off, Wesley blocks this back to the bowler.
A dot to end the over as Raza blocks this one out to the off side.
Horrible start for Zimbabwe as they have lost 3 wickets inside the Powerlay. They need a partnership here. Who will join Wesley Madhevere? Sikandar Raza it will be.

OUT! TIMBER! DRAGGED ON! Unfortunate way to go but he does have to walk back. Pakistan have started off with a bang. They have scalped three wickets in the Powerplay so far. On a good length around off, Williams thinks about guiding this to the third man region and looks to play it late but he does not connect the bat with the meat of the bat and it takes the inside edge and goes onto hit the stumps. Another breakthrough for Pakistan.
Good length outside off, driven straight to the man at mid off.
Outside off on a good length, Madhevere punches this towards mid off for a quick run. There is a throw at the non-striker's end but it is missed.
PLAY AND A MISS! On a good length outside the off pole, Wesley looks to cream this drive but only connects his bat with thin air.
Good length ball around off, tapped towards point for a quick single.
Change in bowling. Faheem Ashraf is introduced into the attack.
Williams pushes this to the off side for a single and will retain the strike for the next over. Another good over by Rauf. Gets his second wicket.
Back of a length ball on leg, Wesley tucks it to square leg for a single.

EDGY FOUR! Zimbabwe are getting a lot of lucky boundaries in the start! Good length delivery around off, Madhevere looks to drive but it goes off his outside edge and goes past the first slip into the third man boundary.
Who will walk out to bat now? It is going to be Wesley Madhevere.

OUT! CAUGHT! The second wicket is down for Zimbabwe and it is their skipper who falls this time. He does not trouble Pakistan yet again and goes back on a cheap. Talking about the delivery, Rauf bowls a back of a length ball on off, Chibhabha looks for the pull but there is no space for the same, so he slices this one towards the short mid-wicket region where Ashraf makes no mistake. The second wicket for Rauf.
LEG BYE! Good length ball on middle, Williams looks to flick but misses and comes off his pads towards the leg side. A leg bye collected.
EDGY FOUR! Lucky, lucky Zimbabwe! On a good length around off, Williams looks to drive but it takes the outside edge and runs away to the third man region for a boundary.
FOUR! Overpitched and punished! 15 runs off this over for Zimbabwe. Hasnain bowls an overpitched delivery around off, Chibhabha lofts this one over the bowler's head nonchalantly for a boundary.
Short of a good length delivery around the pads, Sean tucks this to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Pulled and pulled away fine! What a good shot! Not the best delivery by Hasnain. Short ball on middle, Williams swivels and pulls this one in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
Outside off, Chamu cuts this towards the cover-point region and the fielder does well to stop this one. A single.

EDGY FOUR! Lucky for Zimbabwe! Top edge this time! Back of a length ball outside off, Chibhabha looks to slash at this but it takes the top edge and goes over the slip region and goes past the ropes after a couple of bounces.
Back of a length ball around the pads, Williams tucks this to the leg side for a quick single.
Short ball on middle, Chamu leaves it alone.

EDGY FOUR! Chibhabha gets the first boundary of the innings! On a good length around off and middle, Chibhabha looks to flick this one away but it takes the outer half of the bat and runs away through the cover region to the ropes.
Williams is off the mark! On a good length around off, Williams guides this to the third man region for one.
Who walks out to bat now? Sean Williams it is.

OUT! CAUGHT! Pakistan get their first wicket and the danger man for Zimbabwe departs! A good delivery by Rauf and he gets his man! On a good length outside off, moving away slightly and some extra bounce, Taylor is tempted for the punch to the off side but he does not move his feet and the ball kisses his outside edge and goes into the safe hands of Rizwan. A great start by Pakistan.
EDGY! On a good length around off, Chibhabha looks to flick this but it takes the outside edge and goes towards the third man for one.
An appeal for LBW but turned down. Good length ball around off, Chibhabha looks to defend but it takes the inside edge and hits him on the pads. There is an appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Haris Rauf to bowl from the other end.
A dot to end the first over! Outside off, punched to the man at point. A good start by Pakistan. Just 4 runs off the first over.
Chibhabha opens his account as well! Good length delivery around off, Chibhabha drives this to the right of mid off for a single.
On a good length outside off, Taylor guides this to the third man region for a single.
Outside off, punched to the man at covers.

Zimbabwe and Taylor are off the mark! Back of a length ball on off, Taylor taps this to the off side and takes off for the single. But wait, there is an overthrow here and the batters come back for the second run. Poor from Pakistan.
Hasnain starts off with a good length ball around off, Taylor defends this out to the cover region.
We are all set to begin! The Pakistan players stride out to the middle, followed by Chamu Chibhabha and Brendan Taylor. Mohammad Hasnain will start with the ball. Here we go...

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Brendan Taylor (WK), Chamu Chibhabha (C), Sean Williams, Wesley Madhevere, Sikandar Raza, Ryan Burl, Elton Chigumbura, Tendai Chisoro, Donald Tiripano (IN PLACE OF TENDAI CHATARA), Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava.
Pakistan (Playing XI) - Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam (C), Haider Ali, Mohammad Hafeez, Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Khushdil Shah, Faheem Ashraf, Wahab Riaz, Usman Qadir, Haris Rauf, Mohammad Hasnain.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favour of Pakistan. They have elected to bowl first.

Hello and a warm welcome to one and all for the second T20I between Pakistan and Zimbabwe. The first T20I saw a Pakistan victory courtesy of a great knock by skipper Babar Azam and he will be looking to continue his form into this game and he will look to wrap this series up for Pakistan. Whereas, Zimbabwe, were not up to speed with the bat or the ball, apart from Wesley Madhevere who was good with the bat and they will look to make amends and take this T20I series right to the wire. We are in for a cracker of a contest. Stay tuned as the toss and the team news are coming your way..
